comp_details.recommended_action: Check the configuration of the device at 192.168.100.11 and ensure it is correctly set up. Verify any recent changes and roll back if necessary. Review the device's logs for any error messages or indications of misconfiguration.

ground_truth.root_cause_type: Missing integrated-vtysh configuration file causing FRR daemons (zebra, bgpd, ospfd) to reject valid config lines belonging to other daemons ('No such command on config line N') during startup/config load
ground_truth.recommended_action: Create/restore /etc/frr/vtysh.conf with 'service integrated-vtysh-config' on all four routers, then run 'vtysh -b' to rebuild and re-apply the integrated frr.conf so daemon-specific BGP/OSPF/interface stanzas parse correctly on next reload; treat the MPLS-disable messages, LSA 'Unknown Neighbor' floods, and the single transient BGP reset at 10:13:16 as expected background noise since OSPF/BGP ultimately converged successfully on all nodes.
